faq.q: When should I schedule a boiler tune-up?
faq.a: Ideally in early fall, before the heating season starts. A tune-up catches small problems before they become no-heat calls.

faq.q: Should I repair or replace my old boiler?
faq.a: It depends on age, efficiency and repair costs. We give you an honest comparison with both prices so you can decide.
